name: playback-toggle
title: Play / pause
description: One shape, two states. Continuous in both directions.
docs: Import { PlaybackToggle } from your configured components alias under bera/playback-toggle. Keep its companion CSS. Connect playing to the actual media or animation state, and onPlayingChange to a playback request. Update state from real play, pause, and ended events; handle rejected play promises in the host. The button does not operate media itself. Supply accessible Play/Pause labels and keep native keyboard behavior. The optional local preview is a finite animation, not an audio or video player. Replay changes only the icon, never playback state or callbacks. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/playback-toggle.agent.md
